Three Proposed Change rows name a path inside `plugins/` in the Target File column, which this check scores as a Major finding unconditionally (the check text carries no category carve-out). Row (WFI-020.md line 235): '| `plugins/sdd-quality-loop/skills/quality-gate/SKILL.md` | ... |'. Row (line 236): '| `plugins/sdd-quality-loop/templates/quality-report.template.md` | ... |'. Row (line 238): '| `plugins/sdd-quality-loop/scripts/{emit-run-record.sh,check-evidence-bundle.sh}` | ... |'. This was judged against the repository's own established convention rather than in the abstract: six other plugin-improvement WFIs in this repo (WFI-004, WFI-005, WFI-006, WFI-007, WFI-009, WFI-010) resolve the identical structural tension between wfi-category-guide.md Section 1 (a plugin-improvement WFI's application mechanism IS a GitHub Issue against plugin-side files) and this check's project-side-only text by splitting the section into '### WFI Direct Target (project-side): None' plus a '### GitHub-Issue Lane (plugins/ upstream fix)' table, explicitly flagging the tension for human resolution rather than silently absorbing it. Critically, that softened structure was itself real-audited in this repo and still failed: WFI-009's own Cycle-1 auditor-a record (docs/workflow-improvements/WFI-009-auditor-a.json) scores NO-PLUGIN-SCOPE-CREEP FAIL/Major against that exact lane pattern, even with non-literal descriptive Target File labels, stating 'the WFI's own prose and section header identify both targets as plugin-side scripts/skills, not project-side files, so the affirmative requirement... is unmet regardless of literal string match,' and separately notes WFI-006's own Cycle-1 record scored the identical structure FAIL/Major too. WFI-020 does not even attempt this mitigating structure: its three plugins/ rows sit as ordinary Target File entries in the single unified Proposed Change table alongside AGENTS.md, with no 'WFI Direct Target: None' / GitHub-Issue-Lane separation, and its Rollback-Plan (line 332-338) describes 'the single commit whose message contains WFI-020' touching AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, the template, the tests, and both scripts together as this WFI's own direct application -- a more collapsed, more direct form of plugin-side commitment than any precedent WFI in this repo took. Given the check's literal, unconditional text and this repo's own prior audit history applying it literally even against the softened lane pattern, this is scored as a genuine violation rather than a legitimate, sanctioned consequence of the Category reclassification. `AGENTS.md` and `tests/template-validator-parity.tests.sh` (repo-root, not inside plugins/) are correctly project-side and are not flagged.
